{{Quote|An acquaintance of mine, a Geroon, has a droid that he sometimes hires out as domestic help to members of offworld gentility. This droid told him that he saw a skimmer wearing the seal of Umber House parked near the conapt of the artist Ves Volette on the night of his death. ''[&hellip;]'' I pray that this information may be of some small use to you.|Sele|<ref name="CNII" />}}
Circa [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'' to circa [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Sele (Cathar)|Sele]] told former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] that an acquaintance of [[Gender/Legends|his]], a '''Geroon''', owned a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that he hired out to help individuals from outside Coruscant. The Cathar also informed Pavan that the droid saw someone wearing [[Umber House]]'s seal near artist [[Ves Volette]]'s conapt, hoping that that information was useful to the former Jedi.<ref name="CNII" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Geroon was mentioned in [[Michael Reaves]]' [[2008]] novel ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', the second installment in Reaves's ''[[Star Wars: Coruscant Nights]]'' trilogy.<ref name="CNII" />
